imgDesc.text:
A barrier formed after pure kuuvahki energy condenses. There may be unexpected things sealed within it...
Attack using objects <color=#ffe14b>Suffused</color> with kuuvahki, or unleash kuuvahki by other means to cause them to enter the Suffused state. The barrier will melt as a result.

However, if the barrier is large, it will require multiple charges for it to become <color=#ffe14b>Suffused</color> . By observing the surface of the barrier, you can gauge its current charging progress.

Once fully charged, the Lunar Conflux Barrier will reveal the objects sealed within, becoming <color=#ffe14b>Suffused</color> in the process. At this stage, the Lunar Conflux Barrier will also recharge objects which are susceptible to kuuvahki.
